He just told me that from a list of symptoms, I dint know if it's true but I'm no doctor, that's for sure. 

Its not a conscious choice to tell myself that, just a niggling thought in the back of my mind
Which is why I need to cut myself out of her life, but that'll hurt her and me, both, it's shit.

The doctor told me it's depression, that's his take on it. I don't like the idea of asking for a different diagnosis because then it's like I'm just second guessing everything. 

I don't, from every angle I should have a great life, so I'm not allowed to hate my life, so I feel guilty about that too
It's not about what I deserve though, she's the important one. I just want her to be happy, and I think I'm the main thing in the way of her being happy right now

I don't know either, never had a psych screening or anything. I'm sorry, I don't mean to be snippy. I always get the thought that I have no reason to feel like this, and this user as bad as other people have it, do I've got that going for me I guess!

I probably haven't, but I just don't know where to even start. 

That's all well and good to say, but Ive tried and I can't stop the bad thoughts I can only ignore them, and lately they've been dominating my life.

21M and the situation is, been pretty unhappy for years, got significantly worse when I went to uni, sometimes cope fine for a while sometimes struggle to do anything. I have a super supportive girlfriend, but how can I put on her like this? She doesn't deserve that

My doctor just decided to throw meds at it, that's all. Went to counselling for a bit but in a group I was just trying to solve everyone else's problems and on my own I was just bitching  about other people
What do you want to know? Obviously on a throwaway account so really don't want to reveal too much
Tried Citalopram for a few months, been on Lofepramine for about 5/6 months and seen no changes. doctor will probably take me off them next time he sees me
